description: Carried out technical field inspections while actively providing on-site technical support during the operational transition from paper checklists to a digital inspection web application.
responsibilities: Guided and assisted field inspectors in adopting the new digital inspection application, ensuring a smooth transition with minimal disruption to daily inspection schedules.

Handled first-line application support by investigating issues such as form submission failures, data mismatches, and synchronization errors, identifying whether problems stemmed from user error or system bugs.
Maintained hardware readiness for mobile tablets and diagnosed local network or Wi-Fi connectivity in outdoor workshop environments to keep digital inspection workflows uninterrupted.
Provided day-to-day technical assistance for office and field personnel, resolving hardware, laptop, printer, and operating system issues.
